notes.title: Notice of bug in version 1.5.8
notes.notes: We're sorry, version 1.5.8 has a bug where the folder for saving configuration files has changed from the past. Data that should originally be stored in "AppData / Local / FireAlpaca / FireAlpaca SE" is stored in "AppData / Local / FireAlpacaSteam". We will revert to the old folder at 1.5.9, which will be updated soon. Configuration files such as brushes and palettes are restored. The settings in 1.5.8 will be discarded, so please refrain from working in 1.5.8.
